# Kenney Car Kit

Place the extracted Kenney Car Kit files in this folder.

Expected after install:

```text
License.txt
Previews/sedan.png
Previews/hatchback-sports.png
Previews/taxi.png
Previews/truck.png
Previews/van.png
Previews/delivery.png
Previews/truck-flat.png
Previews/debris-bumper.png
```

Use:

```powershell
.\scripts\install-kenney-car-kit.ps1 -ZipPath "C:\Path\To\kenney_car-kit.zip"
```

The pack license from `License.txt` is CC0.
